name: Claude Code
listChanged: interactive sessions refetch; -p and SDK refresh the list only
allowlist: managed settings: allowedMcpServers entries {serverUrl} (exact or * wildcards) or {serverCommand} (the exact argv, env not compared); a serverName entry is not a security control; allowManagedMcpServersOnly: true makes the managed list the only one (V, managed-mcp docs)
notes: ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} expand in command, args, env, url and headers, user scope included; an unset variable stays literal with a warning in claude mcp list; some credential variable names read as empty in a remote server's url and headers (V, code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp, read 27 Oct). Reserved server names are skipped at load (V, same page). Probe run 27 Oct (2.1.311, `claude mcp get` starting a stdio server with TOKEN set): ${TOKEN} expanded in env and in args (V). add-json writes the object as given, appends the key at the end of mcpServers, rewrites the whole file with JSON.stringify(_, null, 2) and no final newline, and refuses an existing name with exit 1 (V, recorded with 2.1.311). tk keeps the rest of the file byte for byte; Claude Code would re-indent a file not in its own format.
